exposure: History of laparoscopic or laparotomic myomectomy
outcome: Duration of first stage of labor
Rates of prolonged first and second stage of labor
cohort: Women who underwent vaginal delivery at two tertiary care hospitals between January 2019 and January 2020
finding: Women with a history of myomectomy had a lower rate of spontaneous labor onset and a higher rate of emergency cesarean section, primarily due to suspected uterine rupture, but no actual increase in adverse obstetric or neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with a history of myomectomy had an increased rate of emergency cesarean section due to suspected uterine rupture.
